bullets: CAMPING-SPECIFIC DESIGN – 12 TOOLS IN ONE: Engineered specifically for campers, not just a generic multitool. Includes: pliers, wire cutter, locking knife, saw, scissors, tent stake puller, fire starter, bottle opener, can opener, screwdriver, and more. Every tool supports your camping journey—from setup to cooking to takedown.

EASY TENT STAKING & REMOVAL:The integrated stake puller lets you remove tent stakes effortlessly—no more bending or struggling. Combined with the serrated scissors and locking knife, you’re ready to handle rope, webbing, and stakes in seconds.

BUILT-IN FIRESTARTER FOR RELIABLE IGNITION: The removable fire rod is securely held by a snap-fit design—easy to take off and use. Whether you're starting a campfire or in an emergency, you’ll have flame when you need it.
FULL-SIZE SCISSORS – NEXCUT 2.0 SYSTEM: Upgraded serrated scissors deliver powerful cuts through rope, fabric, even food prep. No fumbling—one-step deployment for quick response in the outdoors.

LIGHTWEIGHT & POCKET-FRIENDLY : Weighing only 194g (6.8 oz) and featuring a deep-carry pocket clip, this tool won’t weigh you down. The handle is electrostatically sprayed for a comfortable grip, while all tools are black oxide coated for rust resistance.
